meta.title: Dog grooming services in Hall Green | Keith's K9 Care
meta.description: Full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath & tidy, nail trims, de-matting and hand stripping. IPET-qualified, one dog at a time in Hall Green, Wakefield WF4.

hero.heading: What we do.
hero.body: Six core dog grooming services — from a 45-minute puppy intro right through to a full hand-stripped terrier groom. Every coat type welcome, every dog at their own pace.

overview: Every dog that comes to Keith's K9 Care is groomed one at a time, in a calm home salon — no kennels, no other dogs barking through the wall, and no production line. That setup is the reason nervous dogs, puppies and older dogs settle here, and it lets Keith work at your dog's pace rather than the clock's.

Not sure which service your dog needs? As a rough guide: a full groom (bath, dry, clip and full tidy) every six to eight weeks suits most coats; a bath and tidy is the lighter in-between visit; puppies start with a gentle first groom; wire-coated terriers and schnauzers are best hand stripped; and a quick nail, ear or de-matting visit covers everything between. If you're unsure, send Keith a photo of your dog's coat and he'll tell you honestly what will suit them.
Every price is published in full on the pricing page, with breed examples — and confirmed in person before any work starts, so there are never surprises on the bill.

transparency.heading: All our prices are published.
transparency.description: Most local groomers won't tell you what they charge until you ring. We do — small dogs from £40, medium from £50, large or doodles from £60 for a full groom. Surcharges are listed too.

contactCta.heading: Not sure which service is right for your dog?
contactCta.body: Drop Keith a quick message — he'll help you pick the right slot based on coat, age and any nerves.
